title: Create an account
question: How do I create an account?
answer: Click Sign Up, enter your email and a password, then confirm the verification link we send to your inbox.

title: Reset your password
question: I forgot my password. How can I reset it?
answer: Click Forgot Password on the login page, enter your email, and follow the reset link. The link expires after 30 minutes.

title: Change your email address
question: How do I change the email on my account?
answer: Go to Settings > Profile, enter the new email, and confirm it using the code sent to the new address.

title: Delete your account
question: How do I permanently delete my account?
answer: Open Settings > Privacy > Delete Account. Your data is removed within 30 days and this cannot be undone.

title: Update your profile photo
question: How can I change my profile picture?
answer: In Settings > Profile, click your current photo and upload a JPG or PNG under 5 MB.

title: Unsubscribe from emails
question: How do I stop receiving marketing emails?
answer: Use the Unsubscribe link at the bottom of any email, or turn off promotions in Settings > Notifications.

title: Account locked
question: Why is my account locked?
answer: Accounts lock after five failed login attempts. Wait 15 minutes or reset your password to unlock it immediately.

title: Change your username
question: Can I change my display name?
answer: Yes. Go to Settings > Profile and edit the display name. You can change it once every 30 days.

title: Accepted payment methods
question: Which payment methods do you accept?
answer: We accept Visa, Mastercard, American Express, UPI, net banking, and PayPal.

title: Update card details
question: How do I update my credit card?
answer: Open Settings > Billing > Payment Methods, add the new card, and set it as default.

title: Download invoices
question: Where can I find my invoices?
answer: All invoices are listed under Settings > Billing > History. Click any row to download a PDF.

title: Unexpected charge
question: I was charged but did not expect it. What should I do?
answer: Check Billing History for the charge description. If you still do not recognise it, contact support within 60 days with the transaction date.

title: Cancel subscription
question: How do I cancel my subscription?
answer: Go to Settings > Billing > Subscription and choose Cancel. You keep access until the end of the paid period.

title: Change billing cycle
question: Can I switch from monthly to yearly billing?
answer: Yes. Choose Switch to Annual under Billing > Subscription. Yearly plans save about 20 percent.

title: Apply a coupon code
question: Where do I enter a discount code?
answer: Enter the code in the Promo Code box at checkout and click Apply before paying.

title: Payment failed
question: Why did my payment fail?
answer: Common causes are insufficient funds, an expired card, or a bank block. Try another method or contact your bank.

title: GST and tax details
question: Can I add my GST number to the invoice?
answer: Yes. Add your tax ID under Settings > Billing > Tax Information before placing an order.

title: Delivery times
question: How long does delivery take?
answer: Standard delivery takes 3 to 7 business days. Express delivery takes 1 to 2 business days.

title: Track your order
question: How can I track my package?
answer: Open My Orders and click Track. You will also get a tracking link by email once the order ships.

title: Order is delayed
question: My package has not arrived yet. What now?
answer: Check the tracking page first. If it is more than 3 days past the estimated date, contact support and we will investigate with the carrier.

title: Shipping charges
question: How much does shipping cost?
answer: Shipping is free on orders above 999 rupees. Below that, standard shipping costs 49 rupees.

title: Change delivery address
question: Can I change my shipping address after ordering?
answer: You can edit the address until the order is packed. After that, contact support to request a redirect.

title: International shipping
question: Do you ship outside India?
answer: Yes, to over 40 countries. International orders take 7 to 14 business days and customs duties may apply.

title: Missed delivery
question: I was not home when the courier came. What happens?
answer: The courier will attempt delivery two more times. You can also reschedule from the tracking page.

title: Damaged on arrival
question: My item arrived broken. What should I do?
answer: Take photos of the item and packaging and report it within 48 hours. We will send a replacement or refund.

title: Wrong item received
question: I received the wrong product.
answer: We are sorry about that. Submit a request under My Orders > Report Issue and we will arrange a free pickup and the correct item.

title: Return policy
question: What is your return policy?
answer: You can return most items within 30 days of delivery if they are unused and in original packaging.

title: How to start a return
question: How do I return a product?
answer: Go to My Orders, select the item, click Return, and choose a pickup slot. Pack the item securely.

title: Refund timeline
question: When will I get my money back?
answer: Refunds are issued within 5 to 7 business days after we receive the item, to the original payment method.

title: Exchange an item
question: Can I swap for a different size or colour?
answer: Yes. Choose Exchange instead of Return and select the new variant, subject to stock availability.

title: Non-returnable items
question: Which products cannot be returned?
answer: Perishables, personalised items, opened software, and innerwear cannot be returned for hygiene or licensing reasons.

title: Refund to store credit
question: Can I get store credit instead of a refund?
answer: Yes. Choose Store Credit during the return and it is added to your wallet instantly after pickup.

title: Return window expired
question: It has been 40 days. Can I still return it?
answer: Returns after 30 days are not accepted, but items under warranty can be repaired or replaced.

title: Cancel an order
question: How do I cancel an order I just placed?
answer: You can cancel from My Orders until the item ships. Refunds for cancelled orders arrive within 3 business days.

title: Enable two-factor authentication
question: How do I turn on 2FA?
answer: Go to Settings > Security > Two-Factor Authentication and scan the QR code with an authenticator app.

title: Suspicious activity
question: I think someone else accessed my account.
answer: Change your password immediately, sign out of all devices under Security, and contact support so we can review recent activity.

title: Recognise phishing emails
question: How do I know if an email from you is fake?
answer: We never ask for your password or full card number by email. Check that links point to our official domain.

title: Data privacy
question: How do you protect my personal data?
answer: Data is encrypted in transit and at rest, and we never sell personal information to third parties.

title: Sign out of all devices
question: How can I log out everywhere?
answer: Open Settings > Security > Active Sessions and choose Sign Out of All Devices.

title: Download your data
question: Can I get a copy of the data you hold about me?
answer: Yes. Request an export under Settings > Privacy > Download My Data. It is emailed within 48 hours.

title: Lost authenticator device
question: I lost my phone and cannot get 2FA codes.
answer: Use one of your saved backup codes to sign in, or contact support to verify your identity and reset 2FA.

title: App keeps crashing
question: The mobile app crashes when I open it.
answer: Update to the latest version, restart your phone, and clear the app cache. If it persists, reinstall the app.

title: Website not loading
question: The website is very slow or not loading.
answer: Try a different browser, clear cookies and cache, and check your internet connection. Our status page shows any outages.

title: Supported browsers
question: Which browsers are supported?
answer: We support the latest two versions of Chrome, Firefox, Safari, and Edge.

title: Not receiving verification email
question: I never got the confirmation email.
answer: Check your spam folder, make sure the address is correct, and request a new link from the login page.

title: Enable dark mode
question: Is there a dark theme?
answer: Yes. Open Settings > Appearance and select Dark, or choose System to follow your device.

title: Push notifications not working
question: I am not getting notifications on my phone.
answer: Check that notifications are allowed for the app in your phone settings and enabled in Settings > Notifications.

title: Contact customer support
question: How do I talk to a human?
answer: Use Live Chat from 9 AM to 9 PM IST, or email support at any time and we reply within 24 hours.

title: Upload fails
question: My file upload keeps failing.
answer: Files must be under 25 MB and in PDF, JPG, or PNG format. Check your connection and try again.

title: Change language
question: Can I use the app in Hindi?
answer: Yes. Go to Settings > Language and pick from English, Hindi, Tamil, Bengali, and more.
